title: Straight-Arm Pulldown
summary: A cable pulldown with straight arms, so the lats work without the biceps.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: cable station with an adjustable pulley.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for lats (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.2 for triceps: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Face a high pulley holding a bar or rope, with your arms straight.
Sweep your arms down to your thighs, keeping your elbows nearly locked.
Let them rise slowly until your lats stretch.

form_cues.cue: Sweep the bar down to your thighs
Return until you feel a lat stretch
Think about pulling with your armpits, not your hands.

mistakes.text: Bending the elbows so it turns into a pushdown.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
